sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Inhale, Tactile), Fire Release, Water Release, Clash

system.description:
You expel a powerful bullet of acid from your body. Make a ranged ninjutsu attack against a creature within range, dealing 4d8 acid damage on a hit and forcing the target to make a constitution saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Failure: Affected creature gains 1 rank of Deteriorate or Scaled, your choice.

Critical Failure: Same as failure and they are also Blinded from the intense steam.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Deteriorate or Scaled by +1. If this jutsu it cast at B-Rank or higher increase the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Deteriorate or Scaled by +1. If this jutsu it cast at S-Rank increase the number of creatures you can target by +1.
